title: Release quest-cli 0.6.0 (paired with lore 0.6.0)
description:
User decision, relayed by the orchestrator: publish the quest/lore pair now, decoupled from the opum-workflow plugin's 2026-09-15 observation window. Version agreed with lore-cli: 0.6.0, minor -- new capability (antigravity/GEMINI.md target, multi-select instruction-file prompt) and the migration collision-message fix, nothing breaking on either side's --json envelope, manifest, or existing flag behavior (verified: bootstrap-process.test.ts's full existing suite needed zero edits).

Shape per the runbook (docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md) and the prior 0.5.0 release's own pattern (QCLI-246/242, PRs #311-313): bump version across every hand-edited location, rebuild all six platform binaries locally with the pinned Bun, regenerate CLAUDE.md's quest:agent-instructions block and bun.lock, land as one dev-only prep commit with no tag/promotion/publish yet. Then opum-cli-e2e qualifies this dev tip and lore-cli's together as the release-candidate pair. Then promote dev to main and tag from origin/main (never a local ref). Then dry-run publish, then the real publish only after this session's own user grants that authorization directly -- npm publish is genuinely irreversible and outward-facing, so it goes to my user's gate per the fleet's own escalation rule for irreversible actions, not the orchestrator's.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version bumped across every hand-edited location (package.json, questPlatformPackages checksums, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture) and all six platform binaries rebuilt locally with the pinned Bun (check:packages/test:packages both green), landed as one dev-only prep commit -- no tag, no promotion, no publish yet
opum-cli-e2e qualifies this dev tip paired with lore-cli's release candidate and reports green before tagging

dev promoted to main via the standard fast-forward sequence, then the release tag created from origin/main (never a local ref) and the qualification workflow dispatched against that tag with a passing native-execution receipt

release.yml dispatched dry-run (publish=false) successfully; the real publish (publish=true) happens only after this session's own user grants that authorization directly, not on the orchestrator's instruction alone

Post-publish: clean-install from the registry verified (version/manifest/task/projection/migration smokes), receipt:verify-published passes, and the published version reported back to opum-cli-e2e as the fidelity-suite candidate

implementationNotes: AC1 verification: typecheck/lint/format:check/layer:check all clean. check:packages and test:packages both green after rebuilding all six platform binaries locally with the pinned Bun 1.3.14. bun test flaked intermittently on 1-4 different subprocess-spawning tests per full-suite run (always exit 143/SIGTERM, never a wrong-answer assertion, never the same test twice across three separate full runs) -- confirmed this is machine-wide resource contention, not a regression from this change: every individually-flaked test (cli-tracker-process.test.ts, lore-adapter-boundary.test.ts, backlog.test.ts, backlog-preserve-source-ids.test.ts) passed cleanly and fast (under 2s each) when re-run in isolation, and this machine is confirmed under heavy concurrent load from multiple other active sibling sessions during this exact window. Retried with bun test --timeout 20000 (4x the default) and still saw one flake, ruling out a simple too-tight-default-timeout explanation and pointing to genuine subprocess contention rather than this change's own correctness.
Session pre-compact at 2026-09-09T18:24:51Z. Branch chore/QCLI-258-bump-quest-cli-0.6.0, 21 uncommitted file(s). Written by the opum-workflow pre-compact hook, not by the model.

Dev-prep commit landed: PR #347 squash-merged into dev as ce551cf47297f5822669d671f3d07c0908915479. All required checks (source-gates, operating block digest) and the full six-platform immutable-candidates matrix green. AC#1 satisfied. Next: opum-cli-e2e qualifies this dev tip paired with lore-cli's release candidate (AC#2) before any tag/promotion.

opum-cli-e2e qualified ce551cf47297f5822669d671f3d07c0908915479 paired with lore-cli 771edfa: 426 rows, 414 PASS / 8 FAIL / 4 BLOCKED, every non-PASS explained as a pre-publish artifact (staged install shape, launcher shim unresolvable pre-publish, stale committed receipt, unbound candidate bundle) plus one routine scale-BLOCKED row -- no behavioural defect on either side. AC#2 satisfied. Proceeding to promote dev to main.

prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against v0.6.0 (2 runs: workflow_dispatch #34393839378 and the tag's own push-trigger #34393816487, both conclusion=success). Downloaded and verified the native-execution-receipt artifact from the workflow_dispatch run: describes commit ce551cf47297f5822669d671f3d07c0908915479, version 0.6.0, all 8 jobs success, all six platform executableSha256 digests re-derived from the tracked binary (not copied from manifest). Locally validated: node scripts/qualification/native-execution-receipt.mjs --require --receipt <file> -> 'Native-execution receipt binds 0.6.0 at ce551cf across all six platforms.' AC#3 satisfied (promotion + tag + passing receipt). Per opum-agent: this is the first fresh native receipt at a release tag this cycle, and is the artifact opum-cli-e2e's 6 stale-committed-receipt FAIL rows in 50-packaging were missing -- cited as evidence for QCLI-259.

release.yml dispatched against v0.6.0 with publish=false (run #34394701542, conclusion=success). Log confirms DRY: --dry-run was passed and npm itself logged 'Publishing to https://registry.npmjs.org/ with tag latest and public access (dry-run)' for all seven packages -- nothing actually published. Dry-run half of AC#4 satisfied. Remaining: real publish (publish=true) requires this session's own user's direct authorization, not the orchestrator's -- asking now.

release.yml dispatched with publish=true against v0.6.0 after direct user authorization via AskUserQuestion (not the orchestrator's instruction) -- run #34394929453, conclusion=success. Log confirms real publish, not dry-run: 'DRY:  ' (empty) vs. the prior dry run's 'DRY: --dry-run'; npm logged 'Publishing to https://registry.npmjs.org/ with tag latest and public access' (no '(dry-run)' suffix) for all seven packages. Gate on the receipt passed pre-publish. AC#4 satisfied.

Clean-install verified: fresh scratch dir, npm install @opum-ai/quest@0.6.0 from registry, smoke-tested quest --version (0.6.0), manifest --json, init, task create/list, agents --update-instructions --target antigravity (GEMINI.md written correctly, the new 0.6.0 capability), migration backlog preview against a missing source (clean validation error). receipt:verify-published passed in CI ('Receipt matches every platform package published as 0.6.0'). Published version reported to opum-cli-e2e as the fidelity-suite candidate, paired with lore-cli's own 0.6.0. AC#5 satisfied.
finalSummary:
quest-cli 0.6.0 released and published, paired with lore-cli 0.6.0 (771edfa). Full sequence: version bump landed as one dev-only prep commit (PR #347, all six platform binaries rebuilt locally, ce551cf) -> opum-cli-e2e paired qualification (426 rows, 414 PASS, 8 FAIL/4 BLOCKED all pre-publish-only artifacts, no behavioural defect) -> dev promoted to main via fast-forward, verified against the latest post-PR check-run per required context (not a stale rollup) -> v0.6.0 tagged from origin/main -> prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against the tag, fresh native-execution receipt confirmed at ce551cf across all six platforms -> release.yml dry-run confirmed the publish shape -> real publish authorized directly by this session's own user (not the orchestrator) via AskUserQuestion -> release.yml publish=true succeeded, all seven packages serving 0.6.0, receipt verified against published bytes -> clean-install smoke-tested from the registry (version/manifest/init/task/agents --target antigravity/migration) -> reported to opum-cli-e2e as the fidelity-suite candidate, who independently confirmed 00-identity 18/18 PASS against the real registry install.

Notable finding along the way, not part of this task's scope but consequential: committing the six platform binaries required a non-default git setting (core.bigFileThreshold 32m) to succeed under this session's severe machine-wide memory pressure -- confirmed as the actual lever via controlled comparison (a 95MB binary staged cleanly at 60MB free with the setting, where a 61MB binary was SIGKILLed at 327MB free without it). Filed as QCLI-259 (build-fresh-in-CI redesign) with opum-agent's correction recorded: that redesign alone would not close opum-cli-e2e's 6 stale-committed-receipt FAIL rows in 50-packaging without a matching change in opum-cli-e2e's own receipt-binding plumbing, a genuine cross-repo dependency.
